_doc: Literal. (24 s loop). Real recordings only, credited in CREDITS.md. Built by real-sound/scripts/mix.py from this file and one fragment per category in audio/design/. Cue frames come from out/cues.json, generated from the picture by tools/cues.mjs.
_buses_doc: Music dips 7 dB under each typed query so the keys read (summon to Return), recovers on the Return. It dips 3 dB under the 432 seat and the digit flips (5.2-6.2), 3 dB under the HELLO and こんにちは flips (8.3-9.4) and 2 dB under the QR landing (11.15-11.8) so the tiles read over the hats. It lifts 1.5 dB over the break before the drop and hits at +0 on 14.0, then eases 4 dB down by 16.2 so the wordmark's clacks read. The music edit stops on 18.4. From 22.2 the bus sits at -7, the level the film opens at, so the loop seam has no level step.
_master_doc: -14 LUFS for web and social. Ceiling 0.77 linear leaves room for the AAC encode.
